message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and overall importance:

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest passenger airport in the world; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia, Latin America, and the Pacific Rim. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; major hub for United and American Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) | Dallas/Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Large hub for American Airlines; extensive cargo operations. |
| Denver International Airport (DEN) | Denver, CO | DEN | Largest airport by land area in the U.S.; hub for United and Southwest. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) | New York City, NY | JFK | Major international gateway; hub for many carriers including Delta, American, and JetBlue. |
| San Francisco International Airport (SFO) | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Key hub for flights to Asia and the Pacific; major tech‑industry hub. |
| Seattle‑Tacoma International Airport (SEA) | Seattle, WA | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a major gateway to the Pacific Northwest. |
| Miami International Airport (MIA) | Miami, FL | MIA | Major hub for flights to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Major hub for American Airlines; high volume of domestic traffic. |
| Orlando International Airport (MCO) | Orlando, FL | MCO | Major hub for leisure travel; home to many charter and low‑cost carriers. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) | Newark, NJ | EWR | Major hub for United Airlines; key gateway to the Northeast. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT) | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Major hub for American Airlines; growing cargo hub. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport (DTW) | Detroit, MI | DTW | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; significant cargo operations. |

These airports are among the busiest in terms of passenger numbers, flight operations, and connectivity, serving as critical hubs for both domestic and international travel.
